description: Create a new Agent by composing one or more local Genes. The Agent is saved to .rotifer/agents/ in the project. Genes must exist locally (wrap them first with wrap_gene).

composition.description: Composition strategy (default: Seq for multi-gene, Single for one gene)

domain.description: Domain tag for the agent (e.g. search.web). Metadata only, does not auto-select genes.

gene_ids.description: Array of local gene names to compose (at least one required)

par_merge.description: Merge strategy for Par composition (default: first)

name: create_agent
